what: FB1 features + BlockMatcher, Sinkhorn decode, 1 seed
verdict: baseline

what: probabilistic per-(gene,position) surprisal SHM clock replacing hamming-to-consensus
verdict: rejected: surprisal tracks germline allelic diversity, not the mutation clock (0.311 vs 0.364 single-feature)

what: per-position residue-identity embeddings for the VH/VL interface
verdict: rejected: memorises; residue identity is largely a higher-capacity restatement of the V gene

what: second germline anchor on the conserved FR2 tryptophan to fix alignment drift upstream of CDR2
verdict: rejected: CDR1/CDR2 lengths are germline-constant within a V gene, so there was no drift to fix

what: rebuild germline consensus from the least-mutated half of each gene
verdict: rejected: no change at any keep fraction; the modal consensus is already germline

what: FB3 features (hamming clock at 4 windows + per-gene percentile clock + 13 lift tables + clonal-agreement)
verdict: kept

what: + exact leave-one-out on the lift tables for training rows
verdict: promoted: training rows had contributed their own true pair to the counts

what: + 3 seeds averaged
verdict: promoted

what: exact permutation marginals via Ryser vs Sinkhorn
verdict: promoted: optimal decoder for a rank-linear metric under a pairwise permutation model

what: frozen antibody-LM embeddings extracted on GPU (AntiBERTa2 202M, IgBert 420M, ESM-2 650M)
verdict: inputs for the ablation

what: LM ablation, 5 folds x 3 seeds, all arms on one worker
verdict: promoted all three; memorisation audit passed because ESM-2 (never saw an antibody pairing) captures most of the lift

what: end-to-end fine-tune of IgBert with the listwise block loss, fold 0
verdict: stopped: sequence-only and well behind frozen+features; 10 min/epoch would not fit the delivery budget

what: region-pooled LM embeddings + tokenizer verification
tokenizer_check: BertTokenizer == RoFormerTokenizer input_ids on 800 probes: TRUE
verdict: promoted mean+cdr3; adding fr3 is below resolution and triples the embedding width

what: re-aggregate OOF over coherent sample clusters to probe the 0.25*min(family) term
verdict: the near-zero clusters are entirely mouse/rat; the test set is 100% human so they do not affect the delivered score

what: cold run of solution.py, mean-pooling only (pre-CDR3-pool source)
verdict: pipeline smoke test; superseded by cold2

what: DELIVERED cold run of solution.py
recipe: FB3 features + 3 frozen LMs (mean + CDR3-span pooling) + BlockMatcher, 8 seeds, exact permutation marginals T=1.25
verdict: delivered

what: decoded-error analysis of the incumbent
verdict: no structural defect; representation/capacity is the constraint, not decoder or validation

what: capacity/budget sweep, 5 folds, control 3 seeds OOF 0.5768 human 0.6079
verdict: only seeds and embedding dropout move anything; ensembling saturates ~0.585 however diversity is obtained

what: fine-tuning retested fairly: per-fold AntiBERTa2 FT, embeddings substituted into the same full model
verdict: loses by 0.0058 with an overfitting signature; stopped on low decision value, not refuted

what: within-sample re-blocking augmentation
verdict: CONFOUNDED - 3x data at fixed 14 epochs = 3x optimizer updates, and 22 epochs already overfit; a fair test holds updates constant. Unresolved, not refuted

what: confirm the combination, 5 folds, 16 seeds
verdict: the two wins compose; embedding dropout has a sharp interior optimum at 0.45; pdrop25 delta below resolution, not taken

what: DELIVERED cold run of solution.py
recipe: FB3 features + 3 frozen LMs (whole-chain + CDR3-span pooling) + BlockMatcher, 16 seeds, embedding dropout 0.45, exact permutation marginals T=1.25
verdict: delivered

what: re-blocking retested at MATCHED optimizer updates (K2@5ep vs K0@14ep, 4 seeds, edrop 0.45)
verdict: clean fair negative: -0.054 even at matched updates, so not an exposure artifact. The shipped partition is evidently not uniformly random, so resampled blocks sit off the evaluation distribution

what: 4th/5th encoder (antiberta2-cssp, IgBert_unpaired) on top of the 3-encoder stack
verdict: INCONCLUSIVE - job stalled after feature building with 5 wide embedding matrices resident; no arm completed in ~40 min. Infrastructure, not a result. Untested.

what: 4th encoder + residue-level interface interaction; control = 8 seeds edrop 0.45 (OOF 0.5885 / human 0.6211)
verdict: all negative. Encoder stacking saturates at 3 (the structure-contrastive CSSP, the one with a mechanism, is the worse of the two). Residue-level cross-chain interaction loses 0.0033 on 4/5 folds, so pooled-vector interaction is not leaving reachable residue information on the table. The model4 register_buffer memory bug that stalled enc4 was real and is fixed in model5.

what: marginal temperature, global and block-adaptive, on saved OOF logits
verdict: rejected: +0.0003 / +0.0005 is noise and the fitted per-quintile temperatures are non-monotone (1.4,1.6,1.25,1.9,1.4). The decoder is not the constraint.

what: what separates an easy donor from a hard one (min-family term carries 0.25 weight)
verdict: no single attribute is a clean lever, but the two hardest donors are near-naive repertoires (mean SHM 0.026, 0.035) where the clock has nothing to rank -- motivated the block-gate experiment

what: block-level SHM dispersion gate features (v4 = v3 + 12 block-constant features)
verdict: no effect. Both matched comparisons (same-job 8 seeds; independent local replication) are slightly negative, the one positive is a cross-job 16-seed comparison without a matched arm, and every magnitude ~0.001 is far below the ~0.005 this split resolves. The diagnosed gap is real but closing it buys nothing. Not promoted.
